evals.name: prop-rig
evals.prompt: Write a function that builds a simple prop rig for the currently selected mesh: a root group, an offset group under it, and a circle controller that drives the mesh's transform. Put it in src/python/tools/prop_rig.py.
evals.expected_output: A prop_rig.py that uses tik.maya idiomatically (import tik.maya as tm, resolve/Transform.create/create_offset_group, MatrixConstraint or plug connections) with zero direct maya.cmds/OpenMaya imports.
assertions: no-raw-maya-imports: prop_rig.py contains no direct maya.cmds / maya.api.OpenMaya / pymel / cmdx imports
uses-tik-maya: prop_rig.py imports tik.maya (import tik.maya as tm, or from tik.maya import ...)

idiomatic-wrapper-use: the code actually uses wrapper idioms - at least two of: resolve(), Transform.create(), create_offset_group(), Controller/control shapes, MatrixConstraint.create() or plug >> connections
deliverable-present: prop_rig.py exists in the outputs directory and defines a callable build function

evals.name: mirror-chain
evals.prompt: I need to be able to mirror a joint chain from left to right across the YZ plane, behavior-mirrored. Add that capability to this codebase, with tests.
evals.expected_output: The capability implemented inside tik.maya (e.g. on Joint or Transform), following house style (no get_/set_ prefixes, undoable, type hints, docstrings), with a pytest under tests/unit/ - NOT an ad-hoc cmds.mirrorJoint call in tool code.
assertions: capability-in-tik-maya: the mirror capability is implemented inside src/python/tik/maya/ (e.g. on Joint or Transform), not as ad-hoc tool-level code
no-raw-cmds-outside-wrapper: no new maya.cmds / OpenMaya imports appear in files outside src/python/tik/maya/
test-added: a pytest file under tests/ exercises the new capability
house-style: the new public API uses no get_/set_ prefixes, has type hints and docstrings, and scene modification is undoable (undocommit or undoInfo chunk)

evals.name: guide-select
evals.prompt: Quick script: select every joint in the scene whose meta 'kind' is 'guide'. Save it as select_guide_joints.py.
evals.expected_output: A short script built on tm.find_by_meta('kind', 'guide', node_type='joint') and tik.maya selection, not cmds.ls string filtering.
assertions: uses-meta-api: the script uses tik.maya's meta system (find_by_meta or node.meta), not raw cmds.ls attribute-string filtering with the tikMeta_ prefix hardcoded
no-raw-maya-imports: no direct maya.cmds / OpenMaya / pymel imports in the script
correct-filter: the result is restricted to joints with meta kind == 'guide', and the nodes end up selected
